name: Bizmark
long_description: Bizmark is the bespoke operating system for manufacturers. It connects the systems, spreadsheets, and knowledge a company already has, and turns them into optimized decisions and automated workflows: quotes priced in minutes, schedules that reflow when a machine goes down, inventory balanced between service levels and cash. Working product in weeks, not years. Building it with our first customers now.
one_liner: The bespoke operating system for manufacturers.
